title: Add scripts/gate-summary.ps1: run the check-in gates and print only counts plus complete failure text
outcome: One command runs build, the full test suite, the external MCP harness and the website verifier, and prints a compact machine-terse summary: per-project passed/failed/skipped counts, the complete message and stack of every failing test or harness case (bounded per test with an explicit omitted-line count, never silently cut), skipped names with reasons, the TRX path, and a one-line verdict with a matching exit code; a green run stays around 4 KB so implementer context is not spent on logs.
acceptance: CLAUDE.md Build & Test documents the script as the standard way to run the gates; the raw commands remain listed
No product limit is introduced or changed and no tests are written for the script (owner rule: no tests of infrastructure, build targets, scripts, or repository policy files)

pwsh -NoProfile -File ./scripts/gate-summary.ps1 runs dotnet build (0 warnings check, warnings printed in full), dotnet test on the solution with quiet console verbosity and a TRX logger (existing xunit parallelism caps respected), scripts/test-roslyn-mcp.ps1, and node ./website/verify.mjs; prints per-project counts, every failing test/case with its complete failure text and explicit omitted-line counts, skipped tests with reasons, the TRX path, and GATES GREEN or GATES RED with a non-zero exit code on any failure; a green run prints roughly 4 KB or less

completion.summary: Delivered and committed scripts/gate-summary.ps1 plus matching CLAUDE.md gate documentation in 8a0ede51693945c528117d1b57dfd3662e341385.
